The manner in which Parliament was functioning was unprecedented in Indiaâs history,â he added.Sibal further stated that the Congress would allow Rijiju to speak if he found himself in the opposition in the future: âRijiju ji, please remember: history repeats itself.âClashes broke out between student protesters and security forces in Delhi on July 20 as demonstrators marched towards Parliament, demanding the resignation of then Union education minister Dharmendra Pradhan over the NEET-UG paper controversy.
